# 2026-09-18 — Transform's copied `Start`, and Rough Skin after a Parental Bond first-hit KO

`C:\Users\willj\Projects\Pokemon\ABRA\.claude\worktrees\agent-a0da9d32a6c572dd2`, base `bc270762`.

## Lead 1 — Transform does not run the copied ability's Start

**The premise is TRUE for the Transform MOVE. It is FALSE for Imposter.**

### The authority

- `sim/pokemon.ts:1356`: `transformInto` ends with `this.setAbility(pokemon.ability, this, null, true, true)`.
- `sim/pokemon.ts:1913-1951`: `setAbility` with `isTransform` skips the `SetAbility` event and the `-ability`
  line. At `:1946-1948` it runs `singleEvent('Start', ability, ...)` when
  `!isTransform || oldAbility.id !== ability.id`. So the copied ability's `onStart` runs whenever its id
  differs from the copier's own id.
- Both doors reach this one primitive. Imposter is `data/abilities.ts:2105-2115` (`onSwitchIn` →
  `transformInto`). Transform is `data/moves.ts`, `onHit(target, pokemon) { return pokemon.transformInto(target); }`.
- Champions overrides neither door. `data/mods/champions/{abilities,moves,scripts}.ts` have no `imposter`,
  no `transform` and no `transformInto`.
- Legal carriers were derived with `TeamValidator.checkCanLearn` over the filtered species list. Ditto is
  the only Transform learner and the only Imposter carrier.

### The engine before the fix

- **Imposter:** `runEntryPass` and the lead pass call `imposterCopy` and then `applyEntryEffects` and
  `applyEntryDrops`. So the copied ability's Start already ran. The probe's Imposter arms (Hospitality and
  Intimidate, both entering mid-game) agree with the authority in both knob positions.
- **Transform move:** the `a.kind==='transform'` branch in `battleTurn` called `transformOnto` and then
  `continue`. No Start ran.

### The class, derived

There are 24 legal abilities with an `onStart`: anticipation, cloudnine, curiousmedicine, drizzle,
drought, electricsurge, fairyaura, forecast, forewarn, frisk, gluttony, hospitality, intimidate, klutz,
mimicry, moldbreaker, pressure, sandstream, screencleaner, snowwarning, supersweetsyrup,
supremeoverlord, trace and unnerve. Every one was staged. Each fixture was built so the Start has
something to do:

- **Weather setters:** the partner is a slower setter of a different weather, so its sky is up at the
  lead.
- **The terrain setter:** a faster partner lays Grassy Terrain after the mega has laid Electric Terrain.
- **Curious Medicine:** a faster partner uses Swords Dance first.
- **Everything else:** a foe hits Ditto's partner first.

The results on the clean arm, measured before the fix:

| outcome before the fix | abilities |
|---|---|
| the BOARD parted | Intimidate (both foes' Atk), Super Sweet Syrup (both foes' evasion), Hospitality (partner HP 126 vs 184), Mimicry (types), Drizzle, Drought, Sand Stream, Snow Warning, Electric Surge (weather or terrain), Curious Medicine (partner boosts) |
| only narration parted | Forewarn `-activate`; Pressure, Mold Breaker, Unnerve and Fairy Aura `-ability`. The differential's `ability-announcement` equivalence drops `-ability` lines. |
| inert on the board | Anticipation, Cloud Nine, Forecast, Frisk, Gluttony, Klutz, Screen Cleaner, Supreme Overlord |
| declared, not staged | Trace. It replaces itself at its carrier's own entry, so a Transform copies whatever it traced. |

The weather and terrain rows parted only after the fixture was corrected. The first cut read those
abilities as inert, because the carrier's own lead had already set the same field.

### The fix, at one shared door

- `engine/medicham2-browser.js`, the `transform` branch: when the copied id differs from the copier's,
  it calls `abilityStarted(m, field)`. This is the Start door Skill Swap and the ability rewriters already
  use. Counter: `MEDSEEN.transformCopiedStartRan`. Knob: `MEDI_TRANSFORM_NO_COPIED_START=1`, which
  stamps `MEDFAILS.transformNoCopiedStart`.
- `abilityStarted` now also runs `syncFieldTypes(field, [m])`. Mimicry's `onStart` is only
  `singleEvent('TerrainChange')` (`data/abilities.ts:2573-2575`), and Forecast's is only
  `singleEvent('WeatherChange')` (`:1462-1464`). The entry pass reached these through `syncFieldTypes`,
  but a Start that arrives mid-battle reached neither.
- `syncTerrainTypes` (Mimicry): with no terrain, the authority reverts to `pokemon.baseSpecies.types`
  (`:2592`). For a transformed body that is the UNTRANSFORMED species, and the authority announces it
  with `-start typechange` (`:2596-2598`). The engine read the copied species. It now reads
  `_preTransform.name` and emits the line. Counter: `MEDSEEN.terrainTypeBaseUntransformed`. Knob:
  `MEDI_MIMICRY_TRANSFORM_BLIND=1`, which stamps `MEDFAILS.mimicryTransformBlind`.
- `syncWeatherFormes` (Forecast): the authority returns early on `pokemon.transformed`
  (`data/abilities.ts:1466`). A guard and a counter (`MEDSEEN.formeWeatherRefusedTransformed`) were
  added. **No arm proves this guard**; see OWED.

### Probe

`tests/probe_transform_copied_start.js`. Its latest run is GREEN:

- The clean arm holds on every row: board and lines agree, or the only difference is a declared
  narration gap.
- In the `MEDI_TRANSFORM_NO_COPIED_START=1` child, every live red parts and all three controls hold.
  Curious Medicine parts on the BOARD, because its line is a declared gap. Forewarn is narration-only
  and declared on both doors, so the knob cannot be seen there; the probe prints that rather than
  counting it as a pass.
- The `MEDI_MIMICRY_TRANSFORM_BLIND=1` child parts exactly one arm, `move:mimicry`.

Census row added: `transformsIntoTarget` — *"Transform runs the COPIED ability's Start — a Ditto that copies
Intimidate drops both foes' Attack"*. The control is the same board with a Blaze body, `[0,0]`. The test
reads `[-1,-1]`, and `[0,0]` under the knob.

## Lead 2 — Rough Skin paid twice when a Parental Bond first hit KOs

**The premise is TRUE, and the defect is the whole `onDamagingHit` class on the Parental Bond road.**

### The authority

- `data/abilities.ts:3160-3166`: Parental Bond's `onPrepareHit` sets `move.multihit = 2` and
  `multihitType = 'parentalbond'`. There is no Champions override.
- `data/mods/champions/scripts.ts:461-464`: the Champions hit loop runs
  `if (targets.every(target => !target?.hp)) break;` before it opens any hit. So a second hit never
  opens against a body the first hit killed.
- `runEvent('DamagingHit')` runs inside `spreadMoveHit` once for each hit that landed. Rough Skin
  (`:3928-3934`) is `onDamagingHit` with a contact test, so it pays ONCE. The damage is the attacker's
  `baseMaxhp/8`, because it is contact and not per hit.
- `scripts.ts:548-549`: `-hitcount` is not printed for a Parental Bond click that landed only one hit.
  The fixture therefore counts `-damage` lines, not the count line.
- Iron Barbs has no legal carrier in this format, and its `data/tags.json` row is empty. It could not be
  staged.

### The engine before the fix

`_react` in the step pipeline already used the landed count for the `multiHit` family, which is
`probe_volley_reactor_count.js`'s fix. The Parental Bond road returned `2` flat through `bondMultFor`,
so it never reached that guard.

### The fix, at one shared check

The `multiHit` branch and the Parental Bond branch now go through one landed-count guard. The only
difference between them is the DRAWN count: `_hitsThisUse` for `multiHit` and 2 for Parental Bond.
Counter: `MEDSEEN.bondReactStoppedAtKO`. Knob: `MEDI_BOND_REACT_DRAWN=1`, which stamps
`MEDFAILS.bondReactDrawnRestored`. The branches select on the `multiHit` tag and `bondMultFor`
(`hitsTwice`). Nothing matches on a name.

### Probe

`tests/probe_bond_reactor_ko.js` stages Kangaskhan-Mega. The carrier and its moves are derived from
`hitsTwice` and the learnset.

| arm | authority on the KO turn | medicham before the fix | after the fix |
|---|---|---|---|
| Rough Skin Garchomp / Facade | 1 hit, 1 toll, attacker 70/180 | 2 tolls, 48/180 | 1 toll, 70/180 |
| Gooey Goodra / Thief | 1 hit, 1 Spe drop | 2 Spe drops | 1 drop |
| Gooey Goodra / Facade (KO on hit 2) — control | 2 hits, 2 drops | 2 | 2 |
| Rough Skin Sharpedo / Terrain Pulse (non-contact) — control | 0 tolls | 0 | 0 |

The turns before each KO are a survivor control: two hits and two reactions on both engines. The
`MEDI_BOND_REACT_DRAWN=1` child parts both reds and holds both controls.

Census row added: `hitsTwice` — *"a Parental Bond click whose FIRST arrival kills sets Rough Skin off ONCE"*.
The attacker lost 44 on the control (target survives) and 22 on the test (target at 1 HP). Under the
knob the test reads 44.

> never ran the copied ability's `Start` (`sim/pokemon.ts:1356`, `:1946-1948`). The Imposter door already

## OWED, NOT RUN

- **No release was cut and no board-material measurement was taken.** The two whole-game leads should
  each lose their 2 games on the three team lattices (`--games` 1200 / 1350 / 1950, pinned census and
  `data/team-pool-frozen`). That is a prediction, not a measurement. It needs a cut release and the
  lattice re-run, which is MEASURE's job or a non-light ENGINE pass.
- **Roster and `all_mechanics_fire` were not re-run.** `abilityStarted` now re-syncs field types on
  EVERY Start door (Skill Swap, Entrainment, Worry Seed, Simple Beam). `probe_ability_start_on_rewrite.js`
  held, but no roster stage has seen the change.
- **Forecast's transformed-body guard (`data/abilities.ts:1466`) has no red arm.** It landed with a
  citation because the new `syncFieldTypes` call site can reach it. No probe stages a transformed
  Castform under a changing sky.
- **Curious Medicine's `-clearboost` is missing on every entry, and it is uncounted when the ally had no
  boosts.** This is a pre-existing narration gap on both doors, not Transform-specific. Forewarn's
  `-activate` is the same shape, and it is counted in `entryAnnounceUnmodelled`.
- **Trace copied by Transform is declared, not staged.** The carrier's Trace replaces itself at entry.
- **`receiverSweep` still does not run an inherited ability's Start** (`MEDFAILS.inheritedAbilityStartNotFired`).
  It is the same gap on the Receiver door, and it was out of scope here.
- **CHANGELOG, `docs/RUNNING-NOTES.md` and `status.js --write` were not done**, per the brief. The
